Archer.solo: Wiki: archers 'find it difficult to adventure alone' at times; deep dive adds traps, stances and backward leap for kiting.
Archer.group: Ranged damage with situational utility (traps, debuffs).

Bard.armor: Most armor types (wiki); Wyrmsbane Chain set lists BRD
Bard.solo: Wiki: 'a clever Bard can find success' solo using its wide kit.

Beastmaster.weapons: Two-handed or paired claws; Dual Wield trained at 10 (wiki)
Beastmaster.solo: Pet tanks with Guardian Spirit for solo/small group (deep dive).
Beastmaster.group: Melee + pet damage; pet roles DPS / Tank / Balanced.

Cleric.solo: Wiki: may find difficulty alone except vs. undead.
Cleric.group: Premier healer: heals, cures, dispels, resurrection, Hymn/Blessing of Smiting group buff (L4, patch 0.30.2.1).

Druid.solo: Official class page: 'One of the strongest solo classes'; excels solo through control over animals and self-sufficiency.
Druid.group: Secondary healer, damage, ports, Seasons system (deep dive).

Elementalist.solo: Official class page: performs well solo, pet tanks while you cast from afar. Wiki: four elemental pets by L12; pets need Crushed Malachite reagent.

Enchanter.solo: Wiki: 'may encounter some difficulty' alone; charm damage was reduced in 0.30.0.0.
Enchanter.group: Mez, Sagacity (mana), slows, charm (charm levels 4/12/24/36/48 as of 0.30.2.1).

Fighter.solo: Wiki: most comfortable in a group.
Fighter.group: Premier tank: stances, Retaliation/Vengeance (deep dive). Kick & Shield Bash share a cooldown (0.30.2.1).

Inquisitor.group: Protector / off-tank with caster disruption; Kick back at L3 (0.30.2.1).

Monk.solo: Official class page: capable of soloing thanks to self-reliance and self-healing. Feign Death helps pulling.
Monk.group: Melee damage, pulling with Feign Death (deep dive).

Necromancer.solo: Official class page: 'One of the strongest solo classes in the roster'; undead pet holds the front line.
Necromancer.group: DoTs, life-tap, pet; Locate Corpse at L1 (0.30.2.3).

Paladin.group: Tank with heals/consecrations; Kick back at L3 and Crusader Strike bonus threat (0.30.2.1).

Ranger.solo: Recuperate is for between fights; since 0.30.3.2 (Oct 19) it can't be cast in combat and drops when you enter combat.
Ranger.group: Damage, Wound Care, campfire downtime reduction (deep dive).

Rogue.armor: 'Prefer lighter armor' (wiki); Wyrmsbane Chain set lists ROG
Rogue.solo: Deep dive has a 'Soloability' section; poisons via Poison Making (Rogue-only).
Rogue.group: Backstab damage, pick pocket, lockpicking, disarm traps.

Shadow Knight.weapons: Prefers a two-handed weapon, can use a shield if needed (official class page)
Shadow Knight.solo: Wiki: some success solo through clever magic use. Official: dedicated pets are being cut, so do not plan around a pet.
Shadow Knight.group: Tank with higher damage than a Paladin and less mitigation than a Fighter; life/strength drains shared to self or party; fast short-range abilities (official class page).
Shadow Knight.extra_md:
:::note Shadow Knight rework (official class page)
FACT The official class page says the Shadow Knight is moving to an **antihero monster hunter** identity: collectable abilities learned from monsters (monster lore system), drains and transfers stay central, fast short-range knight abilities are being added, and the **dedicated pet and ability sharing with the Necromancer are being cut**. The wiki spell list below is the current live kit and may change as the rework lands.
:::

## Duo pairings STRATEGY
| Partner | Why | Your job |
|---|---|---|
| Another tank (Inquisitor / SK) | Steady schedule, safe pulls | Agree who main-tanks; the other uses a 2H for damage or a shield to off-tank |
| Spellblade | Burst damage while you hold aggro | Main tank, use drains |
| Necromancer / Elementalist | Pet pressure | Main tank |
| Druid / Shaman | Heal-over-time, slow, ports | Main tank; less greedy with life taps |
| Cleric / Enchanter | Classic heals / mez | Main tank; let them pace pulls |

Spellblade.group: Infusions, damage fields (deep dive); Kick back at L3 (0.30.2.1).

Wizard.group: Burst damage; Volley + Reclaim Magic mana loop and Spark of Magic (0.30.2.1); ports.
